title: Specs Styles Schema
description: JSON Schema for style properties emitted by the Specs Figma plugin

Styles.description: Collection of style properties emitted by Styles.data(). Each property value depends on its type and config.format.tokens setting. Applicable properties vary by element type.

visible.description: Visibility. Can be bound to component prop.

backgroundColor.description: Background fill color. Present on all non-text element types. Represented in Figma as fills.

backgroundImage.description: Image fill painted on a layer. Present on non-text element types. Fallback representation used when no image component is configured. Represented in Figma as an IMAGE-type fill.

fillColor.description: Glyph fill color. Present on GLYPH element type only. Represented in Figma as fills.

textColor.description: Text fill color. Present on TEXT element type only. Represented in Figma as fills.

effects.description: Effect output. TokenReference when the node references a named effects style; Effects when effects are defined inline. Replaces effectStyleId.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius. Scalar when uniform; Corners object when per-corner values differ.

position.description: Layout positioning mode — AUTO (participates in parent auto-layout) or ABSOLUTE. Structural property — not token-bindable.

top.description: Offset from block-start (top) edge. Present when vertical constraint is MIN, STRETCH, or SCALE.

bottom.description: Offset from block-end (bottom) edge. Present when vertical constraint is MAX or STRETCH.

start.description: Offset from inline-start edge. Present when horizontal constraint is MIN, STRETCH, or SCALE.

end.description: Offset from inline-end edge. Present when horizontal constraint is MAX or STRETCH.

centerHorizontalOffset.description: Horizontal offset from center. Present when horizontal constraint is CENTER.

centerVerticalOffset.description: Vertical offset from center. Present when vertical constraint is CENTER.

strokeWeight.description: Stroke weight. Scalar when uniform; Sides object when per-side values differ.

strokeDashPattern.description: Dash pattern for a stroke. Present (non-null) when the stroke is dashed; null or absent when solid.

typography.description: Typography properties. TokenReference when the node references a named text style; Typography when defined inline.

textOverflow.description: How overflowing text is handled — CLIP (cut off) or ELLIPSIS (trailing ellipsis). Structural property — not token-bindable.

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines before ELLIPSIS text overflow applies; null or absent means no limit.

mainAxisAlignment.description: Alignment along the main axis (depends on layoutMode). Structural property — not token-bindable.

crossAxisAlignment.description: Alignment along the cross axis (perpendicular to layoutMode). Structural property — not token-bindable.

layoutMode.description: Auto-layout direction. NONE (no auto-layout), HORIZONTAL (row), or VERTICAL (column).

wrap.description: Whether auto-layout wrapping is enabled (default: false).

wrapAlignment.description: Space distribution between wrapped lines. Only meaningful when wrap is true.

itemSpacing.description: Gap between items. Scalar when uniform; object with horizontal/vertical when axes differ.

padding.description: Padding. Scalar when uniform; Sides object when per-side values differ.

cornerSmoothing.description: Degree of corner smoothing (0 = standard circular corners, 1 = fully smooth iOS-style squircle). Applies to FRAME, COMPONENT, RECTANGLE, POLYGON, STAR, VECTOR, and ELLIPSE element types.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio constraint. Present only when the node has a locked ratio; omitted otherwise.

AspectRatioValue.description: Aspect ratio expressed as a numerator/denominator pair. `x` is the numerator, `y` is the denominator (e.g. x:16, y:9 for 16:9).

AspectRatioStyleValue.description: Aspect ratio value. Object pair when the node has a locked ratio; null when no constraint is active. TokenReference is intentionally excluded — aspect ratio is a structural lock of literal numbers in the Figma API.

NumberStyleValue.description: Pure number style value (from NumberStyle processor)

BooleanBindableStyleValue.description: Boolean style value that can be bound to props or conditional expressions (visible only)

GradientCenter.description: Normalised 2-D centre point used by RADIAL and ANGULAR gradient variants. Both axes are in the range 0–1 relative to the fill bounding box.

GradientStop.description: A single stop in a gradient definition.

position.description: Stop position along the gradient vector, normalised 0–1

oneOf.description: Formatted color string when Config.format.color is non-OBJECT
Stop color as a DTCG Color object
Stop color as a token reference

LinearGradient.description: A linear gradient defined by an angle and two or more colour stops. Maps to linear-gradient() (CSS) or LinearGradient (SwiftUI / Compose).

angle.description: Angle of the gradient line, in degrees

RadialGradient.description: A radial gradient defined by a centre point and two or more colour stops. Maps to radial-gradient() (CSS) or RadialGradient (SwiftUI / Compose).

center.description: Normalised centre point of the gradient ellipse

AngularGradient.description: An angular (conic) gradient defined by a centre point and two or more colour stops. Maps to conic-gradient() (CSS) or AngularGradient (SwiftUI / Compose).

center.description: Normalised centre point of the gradient sweep

GradientValue.description: A discriminated union of the three supported cross-platform gradient types (LINEAR, RADIAL, ANGULAR). The `type` field is the discriminant. DIAMOND is intentionally excluded.

ColorObject.description: Inline resolved color value per DTCG Color Module §4.1. `colorSpace` and `components` are required; `alpha` defaults to 1 (fully opaque) when omitted; `hex` is an optional 6-digit sRGB fallback (#RRGGBB — no alpha channel in hex). Consumers SHOULD prefer `colorSpace` + `components` for rendering.

colorSpace.description: Color space identifier per DTCG Color §4.2 (e.g. 'srgb', 'oklch', 'display-p3').

components.description: Ordered component values (number or 'none' keyword) for the given colorSpace. The number of components and their ranges depend on the colorSpace per DTCG Color §4.2.

alpha.description: Alpha channel 0–1. Defaults to 1 (fully opaque) when omitted.

hex.description: Optional 6-digit sRGB fallback (#RRGGBB). Alpha is excluded per DTCG Color §4.1. Consumers SHOULD prefer colorSpace + components for rendering.

ColorStyleValue.description: Color style value. Covers formatted color string, inline resolved color object, token reference, inline gradient, or null. The string arm is emitted when Config.format.color is set to a non-OBJECT format.

oneOf.description: Formatted color string (e.g. '#FF6600', 'rgba(255,102,0,1)') emitted when Config.format.color is non-OBJECT.
Inline resolved color value with colorSpace, components, optional alpha, and optional 6-digit hex fallback.

ObjectFitValue.description: How the image is fitted to its layer (CSS object-fit vocabulary). Structural property — not token-bindable. Absent means COVER. Transformer remaps Figma FILL->COVER, FIT->CONTAIN, and lossily coerces CROP->COVER, TILE->COVER so no image fill is dropped.

ImageValue.description: An image fill value — a reference into an images registry plus optional fit.

$image.description: Pointer into an images registry, e.g. '#/images/hero' (single-file) or 'card.examples#/images/hero' (concern-split).

ImageStyleValue.description: Container image fill value — an ImageValue object, a TokenReference (when the fill comes from an applied Figma fill style whose paint is an image), or null. Fallback representation used when no image component is configured.

StringStyleValue.description: Pure string style value (from StringStyle processor)

MixedNumberStyleValue.description: Numeric style that can have 'mixed' value (from MixedStyle processor)

MixedStringStyleValue.description: String style that can have 'mixed' value (from MixedStyle processor)

Sides.description: Per-side values using logical inline-axis directions (start/end). Used for padding and strokeWeight when sides differ.

end.description: Inline-end value (right in LTR, left in RTL)

start.description: Inline-start value (left in LTR, right in RTL)

Corners.description: Per-corner values using logical inline-axis directions (topStart/topEnd/bottomStart/bottomEnd). Used for cornerRadius when corners differ.

topStart.description: Top-start corner (top-left in LTR, top-right in RTL)

topEnd.description: Top-end corner (top-right in LTR, top-left in RTL)

bottomEnd.description: Bottom-end corner (bottom-right in LTR, bottom-left in RTL)

bottomStart.description: Bottom-start corner (bottom-left in LTR, bottom-right in RTL)

SidesStyleValue.description: Sides style value. Scalar number when uniform; Sides object when per-side values differ; TokenReference for token binding; null when absent.

CornersStyleValue.description: Corners style value. Scalar number when uniform; Corners object when per-corner values differ; TokenReference for token binding; null when absent.

ItemSpacing.description: Bi-axial item spacing values using absolute visual axes. Used for itemSpacing when horizontal and vertical gaps differ.

ItemSpacingStyleValue.description: Item spacing value. Scalar number when uniform; ItemSpacing object when horizontal and vertical gaps differ; TokenReference for token binding; null when absent.

StrokeDashPattern.description: Dash geometry for a dashed stroke. dash and gap are in pixels and correspond to index 0 and 1 of Figma's strokeDashes array.

StrokeDashPatternStyleValue.description: Dash pattern for a stroke. Present (non-null) when the stroke is dashed; null or absent when solid. Structural property — not token-bindable.

LayoutModeStyleValue.description: Layout mode value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

WrapAlignmentStyleValue.description: Wrap alignment value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

MainAxisAlignmentStyleValue.description: Main axis alignment value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

CrossAxisAlignmentStyleValue.description: Cross axis alignment value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

TextOverflowStyleValue.description: Text overflow handling value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

PositionStyleValue.description: Position value. Structural property — not token-bindable.

PositionOffset.description: Positional offset value. Pixel number, percentage string (SCALE constraint), or null. Not token-bindable.

StyleIdValue.description: Style ID reference (textStyleId; removed from Styles in v0.11.0 — retained for historical reference only)

Shadow.description: A single evaluated shadow. inset distinguishes drop (absent/false) from inner (true). Field names align with the DTCG Format Module shadow token.

inset.description: true for inner shadow; absent or false for drop shadow (DTCG)

oneOf.description: Formatted color string when Config.format.color is non-OBJECT

Blur.description: A single evaluated blur effect. Singular per type; the containing key (layerBlur vs backgroundBlur) determines render role.

Effects.description: Inline effects grouped by role. Each key is optional; a key is omitted when no effects of that type are present on the node.

shadows.description: Ordered list of shadows; Shadow.inset distinguishes drop (absent/false) vs inner (true)

layerBlur.description: Layer blur (filter effect on the node itself)

EffectsStyleValue.description: Effect value. TokenReference when the node references a named effects style; Effects when effects are defined inline.

PropBinding.description: A component-prop binding. Emitted when a property is bound to a Figma component property. Discriminated by $binding to avoid JSON Schema $ref keyword collision.

$binding.description: JSON Pointer to the bound prop within this spec's props block, e.g. '#/props/propName'

ConditionArgs.description: Arguments for a condition expression. value is the prop binding to test; compareTo is the operand for binary operations.

value.description: The prop binding whose value is tested

compareTo.description: Comparison operand for binary operations (equals, notEquals). Omitted for unary operations.

ConditionExpression.description: A declarative condition expression pairing an operation with its arguments.

Conditional.description: A conditional binding. Evaluates the condition against a bound prop and resolves to the then or else branch.

ReferenceValue.description: @deprecated Removed in v1.0.0. Use PropBinding ($binding key) instead.

TokenReference.description: Platform-neutral token reference. $token and $type are the complete platform-facing API surface; $extensions["com.figma"] carries Figma extraction provenance only and is not required by platform consumers.

$token.description: DTCG dot-separated token path, e.g. 'DS Color.Text.Primary'. Usable directly as DTCG alias {DS Color.Text.Primary}.

$type.description: DTCG token type (Format Module §9). 'effects' is a Specs extension for EffectsGroup references (multi-shadow + blur composite) with no DTCG equivalent. 'image' is a Specs extension for fill-style references whose styled paint is an image (ADR-063), likewise without a DTCG equivalent.

$extensions.description: Tool-specific metadata per DTCG §5.2.3 (reverse domain name notation). Not required for platform code generation.

collectionName.description: Figma collection name, e.g. 'DS Color' (variables only)

rawValue.description: Value resolved by Figma at extraction time. No DTCG equivalent; Figma extraction provenance only.

VariableStyle.description: @deprecated Removed in v1.0.0. Use TokenReference instead.

Typography.description: Inline typography properties grouped into a composite object. All fields are optional; only properties set on the text node are present.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels; 'mixed' allowed (mixableNumber primitive)

fontFamily.description: Font family name, 'mixed' when varied, or token reference for variable-bound fonts

fontStyle.description: Style name (e.g., 'Bold'), 'mixed' when varied, or token reference for variable-bound fonts

letterSpacing.description: Letter spacing in pixels; 'mixed' allowed (mixableNumber primitive)

paragraphSpacing.description: Spacing between paragraphs in pixels (pureNumber primitive)

leadingTrim.description: Leading trim mode — 'NONE' or 'CAP_HEIGHT' per Figma API; 'mixed' when varied across selection

listSpacing.description: Spacing for list items in pixels (pureNumber primitive)

hangingPunctuation.description: Whether hanging punctuation is enabled (boolean primitive)

hangingList.description: Whether hanging list is enabled (boolean primitive)

TypographyStyleValue.description: Typography value. TokenReference when the text node references a named text style; Typography when typography is defined inline.
